name: lazy-tabular-transformation-and-validation
intent: Build a reproducible tabular transformation whose logical plan, schema invariants, collection points, and validation evidence are explicit.
successCondition: Stop when the logical plan and bounded materialized result both satisfy the declared schema and data invariants.
outputs: plan schema resource and validation evidence
operations: compose lazy projections filters joins and aggregations
inspect and constrain the execution plan
materialize bounded results and validate counts nulls keys and types
preconditions: source scope and schema are explicit
materialization has a declared resource ceiling
positiveTriggers: Construct a lazy tabular transformation with explicit validation.
Move collection and materialization to measured bounded edges.
negativeTriggers: Read arbitrary datasets outside the supplied scope.
Collect an unbounded plan into memory.
failureModes: stop when the plan crosses the memory or row budget
reject schema drift before downstream materialization
exclusions: does not hide eager operations behind naming
terminationConditions: Stop when the logical plan and bounded materialized result both satisfy the declared schema and data invariants.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-atlas route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
